prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.placeholder: e.g. slow zoom into picture 1, then picture 3 fades in over it

pictures.label: Pictures (optional)
pictures.hint: Up to {max} pictures. Refer to them in the prompt as picture 1, picture 2 and so on.
pictures.tooMany: You can add up to {max} pictures.
pictures.tooLarge: This picture is too large. The maximum size is {limit}.

pictures.loadFailed: The earlier pictures could not be loaded. Add them again.

videoGeneration.estimateUnknown: Estimated cost: unknown for these options

failures.not_a_video: The uploaded file is not a playable video.

failures.provider_unavailable: The video provider is not available right now. Please try again later.
failures.resume_impossible: The server restarted before the provider confirmed this clip. It was not sent again, to avoid a second charge. Please try again.
failures.video_failed: The provider did not return a usable clip. Please try again.
